title: CSCI 630 — Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
subject: Artificial Intelligence
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and explain how each phase addresses specific AI risks.
Explain the distinction between supervised and unsupervised machine learning workflows, emphasizing data leakage prevention and cross-validation.
Apply a practical analysis checklist to evaluate AI system robustness, fairness, and transparency in real-world deployment contexts.
